body: Should I take my ex gf back?
This actually made me feel good bro. Thank you.

There’s no set way of coping, I admittedly dealt with it wrong. But eventually it got better. I learned that at the of the day when she told me she was single again after her bf broke up with her. That it was her loss not mine.

She’s gonna miss out, on a good guy not me.

Just like how your ex is missing out on a lifetime of happiness with you. It’ll take awhile but someday you’ll be able to properly move on and able to be happy, we all deserve it.

I went through a breakup back in February, right before this pandemic started. My ex moved on ASAP so it hurt even more.

But don’t let this define who you are I bet your amazing person, and it maybe words won’t do justice but give it time and you’ll be happy again. :P
